inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The provider was not able to provide a record of the completed safety drill trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The walls in the indoor and outdoor play area have openings that expose the insulation to the children.   There are cleaning supplies in reach of children in the restroom that the children have access to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver has 27 of the 30 required hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The operation was not able to provide the children's records for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The provider does not have a written activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver  -pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR: The primary caregiver daughter was in the home caring for a child  without pediatric first aid and pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver  -pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1209(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The primary caregiver daughter does not have a background check and was in the home caring for a child while the primary caregiver was out doing errands.  Note: The primary caregiver arrived at the home to care for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver: The primary caregiver daughter was in the home caring for a child without all the minimum qualifications for an assistant caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver (26 TAC §747.1209(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The primary caregiver does not have a fenced for the outdoor space where the children play.
Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The primary caregiver has a truck, two vehicles,  in the backyard that is accasble to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: The primary caregiver does not have keeping children safe posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The Primary caregiver was missing 30 hours of annual training for 2022-2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The primary caregiver Pediatric first aid and CPR training expired in 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The primary caregiver has a chain, a motorcycle, a grill, a wheelbarrow, a truck, two vehicles, wires, tires, and nails in the backyard. The primary caregiver also has a ladder and wood on the side of the house.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-License: The primary caregiver does not have the child-care home s license certificate posted.
Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers: The primary caregiver does not have the required posting of emergency telephone numbers.
Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The primary caregiver has boxes, a basket of clothes, and a bend with personal items in the living room where the children are cared for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: The primary caregiver has a bucket and a mop bucket filled with water.  This was corrected when the primary caregiver emptied the bucket of water.    Note: This was corrected when the Primary Caregiver poured out the water from the buckets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3501(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The primary caregiver does not have the recent licensing inspection posted.
